angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 612,216 km at 162.63 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.1489 +/- 0.0136 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 162.63 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.88 +/- 0.05 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of XO-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 612,216 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.88 +/- 0.19 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of XO-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5750 +/- 75 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of XO-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of XO-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/xo-1.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.494, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-1 (pscomppars): spectral type G1 V, from McCullough et al. 2006 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2006ApJ...648.1228M/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-1 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.02 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-1 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.08628, from Raetz et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009AN....330..475R/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-1 (pscomppars): age 0.9 Gyr, from Southworth 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010MNRAS.408.1689S/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/ApJS/276/44/table1 (TIC star magnetic activity with LAMOST DR10 MRS sp.), column Prot: 1.96624 d, the row 0.4 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-1 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.11 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.88 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.049. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
